name: adversarial-validator
description: An isolated, adversarial subagent that validates a security finding before you report it: evidence-only (no hunting context, so it never inherits the finder's optimism), platform-aware severity anchoring (Bugcrowd VRT + a deterministically-computed CVSS 3.1 vector for HackerOne / Intigriti / YesWeHack / Synack / CVD / CVE), an instrument-artifact (false-positive) catalog, machine-checkable per-class proof schemas, and a blunt SUBMIT / PROVE / INVESTIGATE / DISCARD verdict.
